text:
Marco: FYI SI partner flagged a billing delta for last week's marketplace run, looks like hourly usage is truncated to 59m in their ingest.
Anuj: ack, can you paste one of their sample events?
Marco: pasted below from partner — they send minute-level rows but timestamp truncation at ingest: {"resource_id":"edge-az-1","start_ts":"2026-03-19T10:00:00Z","end_ts":"2026-03-19T10:59:00Z","minutes":59}
Sara: oy. that 1 minute drop correlates exactly with our 1% credit reports. likely cause: partner system shifts end_ts when rolling up.
Omar: could be timezone rounding or their windowing job using < end rather than <=.
Anuj: steps: 1) confirm ingest transformer behavior 2) check ledger rollup queries 3) propose backfill for affected windows.
BillingBot: Alert: detected 462 affected hour windows across prod-partner-42 between 2026-03-12 and 2026-03-19.
Li: I'll run a quick query to spot pattern. SQL I plan to run: SELECT resource_id, date_trunc('hour', start_ts) as hour, sum(minutes) FROM partner_raw WHERE partner_id='partner-42' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING sum(minutes) < 60;
Sara: thanks Li. if sum(minutes)=59 for whole hour we know they dropped a minute at boundaries; if staggered it's different.
Li: ok ran it — results show 462 rows, all with end_ts minute = 59 or start_ts minute = 01. suggests their rollup uses exclusive end.
Omar: good catch. action item for SI onboarding team: ask partner to emit inclusive end or provide the raw minute stream so we control rollup.
Marco: short-term remediation: we can patch the transformer to treat end_ts as inclusive if source=partner-42. low-risk feature flag.
Anuj: I like that. add metrics and a toggle. owner @Li for query + patch, @Sara for backfill spec, @Marco to coordinate with partner.
Sara: backfill plan draft: enumerate affected hours, generate synthetic +1 minute events at boundary, ingest into staging ledger, run reconciliation, then apply to prod during 2am maintenance window.
BillingBot: Note: backfill will create adjustments; finance must approve net-credit under $5k. pinging #finance. :warning:
Marco: I'll message partner to explain expected payload changes and get ETA. anyone object to transformer toggle?
Anuj: go ahead, small toggle with feature-flag and monitoring. set rollback if error rate >0.5% in next 24h.
Omar: also add a unit test in partner adapter: sample of inclusive vs exclusive end -> normalized minutes=60.
Li: starting the PR now, will link the patch and tests here.
Marco: thanks team. Sara please draft the backfill runbook in GH and tag billing and finance.
Sara: on it, will create a short runbook and a CSV exporter of affected windows in the repo.
Marco: closing loop: partner contact is emma@si-partners, cc'ing them on plan after we have PR. :thumbsup:
